review_protocol: Initial adversarial review findings were repaired; independent reviewers then checked the exact final candidate and its tree without altering either. A role passes only when no P0-P3 blocking finding remains in that role.

roles.name: business-and-product
attack_questions: Can the bounded administrator role API, candidate record or vendor adapters be mistaken for broader product completion or a published release?
evidence: docs/api/schemas/member.yaml binds role_ids to 100 unique items
MemberController and MemberAdminService reject the same boundary
the qualification record was pending during review and the status page denied publication
the Alpha.13 contract assigns provider SDK, credential, audit and real-provider acceptance to the selecting Host
residual_risks: The 100-item service contract is not a UI usability or production sizing claim.
Vendor adapters being present does not prove a real provider account has passed qualification.

roles.name: saas-and-tenant-architecture
attack_questions: Can evidence-only commits smuggle a Runtime or workflow change after qualification?
Can a storage driver select credentials or tenant ownership implicitly?
evidence: scripts/check-release-candidate checks every post-candidate commit and every merge parent against a fixed evidence allowlist
the verifier compares both package subtrees and content projections to the fixed candidate
Local, Aliyun, Qcloud and Qiniu dependencies are supplied by the Host; driver constructors contain no default credentials
closed_findings: The previous tag workflow accepted any matching manifest version; cc261b1 now binds tag, candidate, evidence and projections.
residual_risks: Storage object ownership and tenant authorization remain an upstream Host responsibility by design.
Real cloud service configuration is outside this source qualification.

roles.name: identity-and-security
attack_questions: Can repeated role IDs bypass the bound and cause an expensive transaction or SQL?
Can a qualification record substitute another candidate or tamper with its evidence?
evidence: the three public MemberAdminService commands count the raw array before deduplication, transaction start or SQL
HTTP rejects the same input before service construction
focused tests require PDO transaction and statement methods never to run on rejection and cover 101 duplicate IDs
the release gate requires exact candidate/tree, Q01 and D05 evidence digests and package projection digests
closed_findings: Unbounded administrator role arrays were closed by 6120124 and 13 tests / 77 assertions.
residual_risks: The 100-item domain bound does not replace Host request-size and authentication controls.
Committed evidence is a controlled maintainer attestation, not an external cryptographic signature of every execution.

roles.name: functional-and-data-authorization
attack_questions: Can concurrent administrator mutations remove the final active Owner?
Does the role bound change empty replacement or tenant scoping semantics?
evidence: aggregate update, role replacement and status transition all lock tenant before member
the final-Owner count remains tenant-bound and is read after the tenant FOR UPDATE lock
a deterministic two-connection MySQL test observed a real data-lock wait and then one success, one LAST_ACTIVE_OWNER_REQUIRED and one remaining active Owner
focused tests preserve legal 100-item and empty-array replacement semantics
closed_findings: The standalone replaceRoles owner race was closed by 1c86fa6 and the real-MySQL 9-test / 61-assertion regression.
residual_risks: The dynamic race test covers two replaceRoles calls; mixed command safety relies on the now-uniform lock order.
Direct database writes outside MemberAdminService remain outside the protected contract.

roles.name: database-and-performance
attack_questions: Do owner serialization, raw role-array validation and storage operations remain bounded before expensive database work?
Did the repaired MySQL persistence paths preserve real integration and registered performance thresholds?
evidence: role_ids over 100 are rejected before transaction or SQL, including duplicate IDs
tenant-before-member row locking serializes final-Owner removal and was observed through performance_schema.data_lock_waits
the corrected Integration retry passed 303 tests / 2937 assertions
all seven registered local performance regression targets passed below their thresholds
closed_findings: MySQL CHECK, native PDO placeholder and JSON replay defects were closed by 4b89dd1.
Unserialized final-Owner removal and unbounded role input were closed by 1c86fa6 and 6120124.
residual_risks: The local regression baseline is not a production SLO, capacity or cloud-latency claim.
The role bound does not prove user-interface ergonomics at the 100-role edge.

roles.name: backend-module-architecture
attack_questions: Do the four storage implementations remain low-level product-neutral drivers with explicit Host dependencies?
Can the release evidence commit alter a Module, Runtime boundary or package projection?
evidence: Local, Aliyun, Qcloud and Qiniu drivers implement the FileMedia storage contract without importing Peanut Admin product models
optional provider SDK classes are isolated in the accepted StorageProviderSdks dependency layer
scripts/check-release-candidate rejects Runtime, workflow, verifier, lock or package changes after the candidate
final package inspection found 728 Composer files across 13 Runtime PSR-4 roots and 73 npm packed files with 14 exports
closed_findings: The optional vendor SDK dependency boundary was explicitly classified by 23ec256.
residual_risks: The drivers deliberately do not own tenant authorization, credentials or audit policy.
Application adoption is a separate downstream lock and Host-wiring qualification.

roles.name: frontend-and-admin-ux
attack_questions: Did the browser repair weaken assertions or replace business readiness with a longer URL timeout?
evidence: the Reference Codes flow awaits and asserts login, tenant selection and the real menus request at HTTP 200 before checking the requested workspace
the router completes context and navigation loading before successful entry
the focused browser retry passed 46/46
closed_findings: The five-second URL race was replaced by explicit tenant-workspace readiness in ec504c1.
residual_risks: Final fixed-commit review did not repeat the unaffected browser matrix.
A non-blocking production bundle-size warning remains.

roles.name: open-source-maintainability
attack_questions: Can a maintainer reproduce the package boundary and release decision without private paths, stale version-specific scripts or mutable tag assumptions?
Do dependency, license and vendor-support declarations remain explicit and reviewable?
evidence: the generic release verifier has 17 isolated real-Git regression cases and replaced the stale Alpha.5 executable path
Composer and npm projections are content-hashed from the fixed candidate and package dry-run/tar lists agree
license inventory, dependency audit, secret scan and clean Starter gates passed in the continuation
provider SDKs remain optional suggestions and selecting Hosts own installation, credentials and acceptance
closed_findings: The stale Alpha.5 preflight entry points were retired by cc261b1.
Starter documentation was aligned to the unpublished Alpha.13 candidate by 212cc15.
residual_risks: Local npm credentials were not used as release evidence; registry publication depends on the protected GitHub environment.
Packagist maintainer refresh and clean public consumers remain post-tag publication checks.
Historical Alpha.2 manual projection entry points remain tracked outside the current release path and may confuse maintainers; retire or mark them explicitly historical after Alpha.13.

roles.name: low-context-delivery
attack_questions: Can a constrained maintainer distinguish an unpublished fixture, a qualified candidate and a released package, and execute the exact gate?
evidence: Starter README and the internal Starter guide identify 0.1.0-alpha.13 as a local unpublished candidate
the release qualification guide documents candidate freeze, evidence-only commits, the exact record fields and verifier commands
a pending record always rejects and all source-tag publication steps run the committed verifier
closed_findings: Starter pages that named Alpha.2 or generic 0.1.0 were corrected by 212cc15.
residual_risks: The Starter remains a fixed internal fixture, not a public configurable generator.
Publication and downstream adoption are still separate states after this review.

closed_findings.summary: Concurrent standalone owner-role removal could leave no active Owner.
Administrator role arrays were not consistently bounded before transaction and SQL.
The source tag workflow was not cryptographically bound to fixed Q01/D05 evidence and package projections.
Starter documentation exposed stale package identities.

open_blocking_findings.summary: Q01/D05 evidence and the passing qualification record must be committed and reviewed before the maintainability role can pass.
open_blocking_findings.disposition: procedural stop line; close only in a later evidence-only commit

review_limitations: This review approves the fixed source candidate for the Alpha.13 publication gate; it does not itself prove Registry publication or downstream adoption.
Real Aliyun, Qcloud and Qiniu credentials and provider endpoints were not exercised.
Production sizing, observability, backup objectives and application deployment remain Host responsibilities.
